# Pune AI Collective

Pune AI Collective is a community-driven organization empowering Pune's AI ecosystem through knowledge sharing, collaborative projects, and skill development.

## About

/ — Homepage with mission, vision, and community overview
The Pune AI Collective brings together AI enthusiasts, researchers, and professionals in Pune to facilitate knowledge sharing and collaborative innovation in artificial intelligence.

**Mission:** Empower Pune's AI community by facilitating knowledge sharing, collaborative projects, and skill development through accessible events and resources.

**Vision:** Establish Pune as a globally recognized epicenter of AI innovation.

## Community Pages

/show-and-tell.html — Submit AI projects and innovations
Community members can share their AI projects, experiments, research, and innovations with the broader Pune AI community through this submission portal.

/people.html — Core team members directory
Meet the core team behind Pune AI Collective. Each member has a dedicated page with their profile and machine-readable CV.

## People (Individual Profiles & CVs)

/people/deepak/ — Profile page for Deepak Koul, Community Lead
/people/deepak/cv.txt — Machine-readable CV for Deepak Koul
Senior Manager, Software Engineering at Red Hat. 19+ years experience. Founding member and community lead. Keynote speaker at ATAGTR, FOSSASIA, MCP Dev Summit, SeleniumConf.

/people/deep/ — Profile page for Deep Gandhi, Principal Software Engineer
/people/deep/cv.txt — Machine-readable CV for Deep Gandhi
Principal Software Engineer at Red Hat. 12+ years in Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG, and Enterprise AI Architecture. Architected Ask Red Hat and Enterprise AI Evaluation Framework.

/people/abhishek/ — Profile page for Abhishek Kumar, Senior Principal Software Engineer
/people/abhishek/cv.txt — Machine-readable CV for Abhishek Kumar
Senior Principal Software Engineer & Technical Architect at Red Hat. 8+ years in enterprise architecture, AI enablement, and cloud-native platforms. Leading Red Hat IT AI Factory & MCP POD. Linux Foundation MCP Dev Summit keynote speaker. Co-founder of Pune AI Collective.

## Events

**Meetups:** Regular quarterly events bringing together AI enthusiasts for knowledge sharing, networking, and collaboration.
- 2 meetups completed as of May 2026
- Topics include: AI fundamentals, LLMs, prompt engineering, machine learning applications
- Future meetups announced via LinkedIn and WhatsApp

## Getting Involved

1. Join the LinkedIn Group or WhatsApp Community
2. Attend upcoming meetups (check homepage for dates)
3. Submit your AI projects via Show and Tell
4. Contribute to GitHub projects
5. Network with Pune's AI community

## Contact

For inquiries, collaboration opportunities, or event sponsorship:
- Visit the homepage Contact section
- Connect via social channels (LinkedIn, WhatsApp, GitHub)
